text:
ada: Starting a focused week-long sweep for admin/KMS entitlement pruning. Objective: produce a safe candidate set, run staging dry-runs, owner outreach, then a guarded prod window.

frank: Scope? Prefer to exclude keys used by CI and any key with >5 accesses/day.

mona: We'll pull entitlements and join with KMS logs + CI registry. Quick export for those who want to run locally:
```
./tools/ent list --since=2024-01-01 --filter='role:admin OR resource:kms' > /tmp/ent.csv
```

ada: Typo: @mona :) Also add `--include=owner,rotation_policy,last_used` to the export.

mona: Good call. Plan: run BigQuery join to get `last_seen`, `usage_count`, `job_refs`. SQL prototype posted in my drive.

sec-automate: snapshot saved: `gs://sec-backups/ent-snap-1745600000.json` (3.2MB, 2,231 entries). Use `./tools/ent apply --from=...` to restore.

frank: Canary idea: pick 4 low-traffic keys from staging with single owner. Remove admin role there, run scheduler replay + smoke tests for 36h, monitor `kms.access_denied` and `batch.fail_rate`. Auto-rollback if >5 denied errors in 15m.

ada: Outreach template (short): "Hi @<owner>, audit found admin access to key <key_id> with no usage in X days. Reply within 48h to keep access or we'll remove it. If this is used by a job, link the runbook."

mona: Will tag any key with `third_party=true` or `multi_owner=true` as manual-review. Also flag keys referenced in recent vuln tickets (do not touch).

frank: I'll add a webhook that creates a ticket for each candidate and includes an approve link. If owner absent, assign to `sec-oncall`.

mona: Staging dry-run scheduled Mon 09:00 PT. I'll post the CSV of candidates after the log joins.

ada: Meeting Thurs 11:00 to review final candidates and accept canary. If staging shows odd failures, page sec-oncall and rollback immediately.

audit-bot: candidate list generated: 32 flagged, 9 ownerless, 6 blocked by vuln-tag. Link: https://internal/reports/ent-cleanup/1745600000.csv

frank: Thanks. Keeping this surgical and well-instrumented. :lock:
